edges.mechanism: 200 mg aqueous extract reduced propranolol AUC by 29% and Cmax by 42% and prolonged Tmax ~86% via reduced absorption; elimination half-life unchanged.
edges.evidence: Randomized single-blind crossover PK study in 14 healthy men; no pharmacodynamic change in healthy volunteers; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Absorption-reducing interaction shown for propranolol may extend to other orally absorbed beta-blockers; antihypertensive response could be blunted.
edges.evidence: Extrapolation from a single propranolol PK study; not studied for other agents; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Root extract weakly inhibited CYP1A2 in human liver microsomes (IC50 324.9 ug/mL); eurycomanone itself not a potent inhibitor.
edges.evidence: In vitro only; IC50 values likely above achievable concentrations; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Root extract weakly inhibited CYP2C19 (IC50 562.9 ug/mL) and CYP2A6 (797.1 ug/mL).
edges.evidence: In vitro only; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Extract inhibited CYP2C8-catalyzed amodiaquine N-desethylation with Ki about 4 times that of quercetin; authors suggest possible in vivo relevance.
edges.evidence: In vitro only; no human study; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Eurycomanone did not potently inhibit CYP3A4 (IC50 >250 ug/mL); interaction via CYP3A4 considered unlikely by authors.
edges.evidence: In vitro, largely reassuring; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Tongkat ali raises total testosterone (MA SMD 1.352) and DHEA; additive androgen exposure with testosterone therapy plausible; rat bone study combined EL with low-dose testosterone.
edges.evidence: MA of 5 small RCTs plus RCT; no human combination study; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Eurycomanone inhibits aromatase in Leydig cells and enhanced formestane inhibition in vitro, yet estradiol rose in young men; net effect on estrogen-modulating therapy unclear.
edges.evidence: In vitro mechanism plus one small human trial; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Canthin-6-one alkaloids inhibit PDE-5 in vitro; some tongkat ali products were found adulterated with sildenafil analogues, creating hidden additive exposure (e.g. with nitrates).
edges.evidence: In vitro mechanism plus product adulteration survey; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Root subfraction inhibited ACE and AT1 signalling and relaxed rat aorta; additive BP lowering is mechanistic only.
edges.evidence: Rat ex vivo/in vitro only; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Antihyperglycemic in db/db mice (PDX1/beta-cell expansion) and STZ rats at 150 mg/kg; no effect in normoglycemic rats; additive glucose lowering is mechanistic inference.
edges.evidence: Animal data only; HbA1c not reported changed in human RCT; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Powdered root shortened PT and aPTT in rats; tongkat ali coffee lowered platelet counts in chronically dosed male rats; clinical direction unknown.
edges.evidence: Rat toxicology only; no human data; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Clinically apparent liver injury attributed to tongkat ali has been reported; stacking hepatotoxic agents adds risk.
edges.evidence: Case report and LiverTox entry; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Raises testosterone; prostate cancer is a debated contraindication to testosterone therapy; LNCaP anti-proliferative data are in vitro only and do not establish safety.
edges.evidence: MA (hormone effect) plus reviews and in vitro data; very low certainty for clinical harm

edges.mechanism: Increases testosterone and estradiol and lowers SHBG in some populations; effects in androgen- or estrogen-sensitive disease unstudied.
edges.evidence: Human RCTs of hormone biomarkers; no disease-outcome data; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Safety not established; EU novel-food application excluded pregnant and lactating women and EFSA concluded safety not established under any condition of use (genotoxicity signal).
edges.evidence: Regulatory opinion; rat teratology NOAEL 100 mg/kg/day; no human data

edges.mechanism: No human data; excluded from EU novel-food target population.
edges.evidence: Regulatory opinion only

edges.mechanism: Reported herb-induced liver injury (jaundice, raised enzymes) resolving on withdrawal.
edges.evidence: Single case report plus LiverTox; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Probable case of new-onset atrial flutter after starting tongkat ali in a 71-year-old.
edges.evidence: Single case report; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: True physiological increase in total/free testosterone (not an assay artifact); interpret androgen panels in light of use.
edges.evidence: RCTs and MA; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Physiological shifts: estradiol up (young men), SHBG down (older women), DHEA up and cortisol down.
edges.evidence: Small RCTs and pilot study; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Both classed as possibly effective testosterone boosters; additive androgenic effect is a mechanistic inference.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic inference from systematic/critical reviews; no combination study

edges.mechanism: Physta raised DHEA within-group; combined androgen-precursor load is a mechanistic inference.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic inference from one RCT; no interaction study
